title: Animal
subtitle: 「動物」，有哪些真正接近、幾乎可以互換的說法？
description: 「動物」，有哪些真正接近、幾乎可以互換的說法？

words.note: 和 animal 很接近，尤其在一般敘述、文學、兒童內容和非技術語境中。
words.example: The forest is home to many strange creatures.
words.exampleZh: 森林是許多奇特動物的棲息地。

exercises.original: The cave is home to several unusual animals.
exercises.zh: 這個洞穴是幾種奇特動物的棲息地。
exercises.upgrade: The cave is home to several unusual creatures.

options.explanation: 一般描述中和 animals 非常接近。
species 是分類單位，不一定指具體個體。

exercises.original: The children were excited to see the small animals in the pond.
exercises.zh: 孩子們看到池塘裡的小動物時很興奮。
exercises.upgrade: The children were excited to see the small creatures in the pond.

options.explanation: 池塘生物不一定是哺乳動物。

exercises.original: No animal should be treated cruelly.
exercises.zh: 任何動物都不應受到殘酷對待。
exercises.upgrade: No creature should be treated cruelly.

options.explanation: 倫理／一般敘述中非常自然。

words.note: 比單獨的 creature 更明確強調「有生命」。
words.example: Every living creature needs access to water.
words.exampleZh: 每一種生物都需要取得水源。

exercises.original: Every animal needs water to survive.
exercises.zh: 每一種有生命的動物都需要水才能生存。
exercises.upgrade: Every living creature needs water to survive.

options.explanation: 和 animal 很接近，並強調生命狀態。

exercises.original: The rescue team searched for any animals trapped inside.
exercises.zh: 救援隊搜尋是否有任何受困的生物。
exercises.upgrade: The rescue team searched for any living creatures trapped inside.

options.explanation: 如果重點是尋找任何有生命的動物，很自然。

exercises.original: The desert may look empty, but many animals live there.
exercises.zh: 沙漠看起來可能很空，但其實有很多生物居住。
exercises.upgrade: The desert may look empty, but many living creatures live there.

words.note: 表示任何有生命的存在。
words.example: The law is intended to prevent unnecessary suffering to living beings.
words.exampleZh: 這項法律旨在防止生物受到不必要的痛苦。

exercises.original: The organisation believes every animal deserves humane treatment.
exercises.zh: 該組織認為每一個有生命的存在都應受到人道對待。
exercises.upgrade: The organisation believes every living being deserves humane treatment.

options.explanation: 倫理語境中和 animal 很接近，但範圍更廣。

exercises.original: Scientists must consider the welfare of every animal used in the study.
exercises.zh: 科學家必須考慮研究中每個生物的福祉。
exercises.upgrade: Scientists must consider the welfare of every living being used in the study.

options.explanation: 如果重點是生命與福祉，可與 animal 接近。
過於技術且不等於動物。

exercises.original: The philosophy treats humans and animals as living entities deserving respect.
exercises.zh: 這種哲學把人和動物都視為應受尊重的生命存在。
exercises.upgrade: The philosophy treats humans and animals as living beings deserving respect.

options.explanation: 此處特別適合，因為它可以同時包括人和動物。

words.note: 較文學化或帶感情色彩，可指大型、野生或令人畏懼的動物。
words.example: The hunters tracked the beast through the forest.
words.exampleZh: 獵人沿著森林追蹤那頭野獸。

exercises.original: The villagers were afraid of the wild animal in the forest.
exercises.zh: 村民害怕森林裡的那頭野獸。
exercises.upgrade: The villagers were afraid of the beast in the forest.

options.explanation: 帶有野性、威脅和文學感。

exercises.original: The hunter followed the animal's tracks through the snow.
exercises.zh: 獵人沿著雪地追蹤那頭野獸的足跡。
exercises.upgrade: The hunter followed the beast's tracks through the snow.

exercises.original: The story describes a huge animal living in the mountains.
exercises.zh: 故事描述一頭住在山中的巨大野獸。
exercises.upgrade: The story describes a huge beast living in the mountains.

options.explanation: 故事語境和巨大野獸非常匹配。

words.note: 指自然環境中的野生動物，通常作集合名詞。
words.exampleZh: 這個公園保護當地野生動物。

exercises.original: The national park protects wild animals.
exercises.zh: 國家公園保護野生動物。
exercises.upgrade: The national park protects wildlife.

exercises.original: Tourists come to the area to see native animals.
exercises.zh: 遊客來這個地區觀賞本地野生動物。
exercises.upgrade: Tourists come to the area to see native wildlife.

options.explanation: 旅遊和自然觀察語境非常自然。

exercises.original: Road construction may disturb local wild animals.
exercises.zh: 道路工程可能會干擾當地野生動物。
exercises.upgrade: Road construction may disturb local wildlife.

words.note: 較正式／科學，指某地區、時期或生態系統中的動物群。
words.example: The island has unique native fauna.
words.exampleZh: 這個島嶼擁有獨特的本地動物群。

exercises.original: The island has many unique native animals.
exercises.zh: 這個島嶼擁有許多獨特的本地動物群。
exercises.upgrade: The island has unique native fauna.

options.explanation: 正式地表示某地區的動物群。

exercises.original: Researchers documented the animals of the rainforest.
exercises.zh: 研究人員記錄了熱帶雨林的動物群。
exercises.upgrade: Researchers documented the fauna of the rainforest.

options.explanation: 生態／研究語境非常自然。

exercises.original: The region's animals have adapted to extreme heat.
exercises.zh: 該地區的動物群已適應極端高溫。
exercises.upgrade: The region's fauna has adapted to extreme heat.

options.explanation: 表示整個地區的動物群。

words.note: 科學語境中指任何有生命的個體。
words.example: The organism survives in extremely cold water.
words.exampleZh: 這種生物能在極冷的水中生存。

exercises.original: This tiny animal can survive in very cold water.
exercises.zh: 這種微小生物能在極冷的水中生存。
exercises.upgrade: This tiny organism can survive in very cold water.

options.explanation: 科學語境中自然，但範圍比 animal 更廣。

exercises.original: Scientists observed how the animal responded to changes in temperature.
exercises.zh: 科學家觀察這個生物如何對溫度變化作出反應。
exercises.upgrade: Scientists observed how the organism responded to changes in temperature.

options.explanation: 實驗／生物學語境中自然。

exercises.original: The animal reproduces rapidly under warm conditions.
exercises.zh: 這種生物在溫暖環境下繁殖很快。
exercises.upgrade: The organism reproduces rapidly under warm conditions.

words.note: 指某地區或環境中的動物整體。
words.example: The wetland supports a rich variety of animal life.
words.exampleZh: 這片濕地孕育了豐富多樣的動物生命。

exercises.original: The wetland supports many animals.
exercises.zh: 這片濕地孕育豐富的動物生命。
exercises.upgrade: The wetland supports rich animal life.

options.explanation: 表示環境中的動物整體。

exercises.original: Pollution has affected animals in the river.
exercises.zh: 污染影響了河流中的動物生命。
exercises.upgrade: Pollution has affected animal life in the river.

exercises.original: The desert contains more animals than it first appears to.
exercises.zh: 沙漠中的動物生命比表面看來更豐富。
exercises.upgrade: The desert contains more animal life than it first appears to.

options.explanation: 自然地指某環境中的動物整體。

falseSynonyms.zh: 寵物不等於所有動物 pet 只指被人飼養作伴的動物。
falseSynonyms.point: A dog can be a pet. A tiger is an animal but usually not a pet.

falseSynonyms.zh: 物種不等於動物個體 species 是生物分類單位，不是 animal 的直接同義詞。
哺乳動物不等於所有動物 所有 mammals 都是 animals，但很多 animals 不是 mammals。
昆蟲只是動物的一類 insect 是 animal kingdom 中的一部分。
人類在生物學上是動物，但日常語言通常分開說 在科學上 humans are animals；在日常語境中，people and animals 往往把兩者分開。
集合名詞與單體名詞不同 不能說：
falseSynonyms.point: We saw a wild animal. We saw lots of wildlife. ❌ We saw a wildlife.
